```diff
@@ -1,2 +1,155 @@

+ use anyhow::Result;
+ use arrow::array::{Int64Array, ListArray, UInt32Array};
+ use arrow::datatypes::{DataType, Field, Schema};
+ use arrow::record_batch::RecordBatch;
+ use hf_hub::{api::sync::Api, Repo, RepoType};
+ use lance::dataset::WriteParams;
+ use lance::Arrow;
+ use rand::SeedableRng;
+ use rand::seq::SliceRandom;
+ use std::path::Path;
+ use std::sync::Arc;
+ use tokenizers::Tokenizer;
+ 
+ fn main() -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {
+     // Set up tokio runtime
+     let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new()?;
+     rt.block_on(async {
+         // Load tokenizer from Hugging Face
+         let tokenizer = load_tokenizer("gpt2")?;
+         
+         // Load dataset
+         println!("Loading dataset...");
+         let dataset_path = Path::new("src/wikitext-103-raw-v1/data");
+         
+         // Process the train parquet files
+         let mut samples = Vec::new();
+         let train_files = vec![
+             "train-00000-of-00002-b755d19de94348c6.parquet",
+             "train-00001-of-00002-0bf6d0c487c2e75b.parquet",
+         ];
+         
+         for file in train_files {
+             let file_path = dataset_path.join(file);
+             println!("Processing {}", file_path.display());
+             
+             let parquet_file = arrow::parquet::arrow::ParquetFileArrowReader::try_new(
+                 std::fs::File::open(file_path)?
+             )?;
+             
+             let record_reader = parquet_file.get_record_reader(1024)?;
+             for maybe_batch in record_reader {
+                 let batch = maybe_batch?;
+                 let text_array = batch.column_by_name("text")
+                     .expect("No 'text' column found")
+                     .as_string::&lt;arrow::array::StringArray&gt;();
+                 
+                 for i in 0..text_array.len() {
+                     if samples.len() &gt;= 500_000 {
+                         break;
+                     }
+                     if let Some(text) = text_array.value(i) {
+                         if !text.is_empty() {
+                             // Tokenize the text
+                             let encoding = tokenizer.encode(text, false)?;
+                             let input_ids = encoding.get_ids().iter()
+                                 .map(|&amp;id| id as i64)
+                                 .collect::&lt;Vec&lt;_&gt;&gt;();
+                             
+                             samples.push(input_ids);
+                         }
+                     }
+                 }
+                 
+                 if samples.len() &gt;= 500_000 {
+                     break;
+                 }
+             }
+             
+             if samples.len() &gt;= 500_000 {
+                 println!("Collected {} samples", samples.len());
+                 break;
+             }
+         }
+         
+         // Shuffle the samples (like in Python version)
+         let mut rng = rand::rngs::StdRng::seed_from_u64(1337);
+         samples.shuffle(&amp;mut rng);
+         
+         // Limit to 500K samples
+         if samples.len() &gt; 500_000 {
+             samples.truncate(500_000);
+         }
+         
+         // Create schema
+         let schema = Arc::new(Schema::new(vec![
+             Field::new("input_ids", DataType::List(Arc::new(Field::new("item", DataType::Int64, false))), false)
+         ]));
+         
+         // Create record batch
+         let input_ids_array = create_list_array_from_vectors(&amp;samples)?;
+         let batch = RecordBatch::try_new(
+             schema.clone(),
+             vec![Arc::new(input_ids_array)]
+         )?;
+         
+         // Save as Lance dataset
+         println!("Writing to Lance dataset...");
+         let dataset_path = "wikitext_500K.lance";
+         lance::dataset::write_dataset(&amp;batch, dataset_path, None, &amp;WriteParams::default()).await?;
+         
+         // Read and verify the dataset
+         let ds = lance::dataset::Dataset::open(dataset_path).await?;
+         let table = ds.to_table().await?;
+         println!("Number of rows: {}", table.num_rows());
+         
+         Ok(())
+     })
+ }
+ 
+ fn load_tokenizer(model_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Tokenizer&gt; {
+     // Download tokenizer from Hugging Face
+     let api = Api::new()?;
+     let repo = api.repo(Repo::with_revision(
+         model_name.into(),
+         RepoType::Model,
+         "main".into(),
+     ));
+     
+     let tokenizer_path = repo.get("tokenizer.json")?;
+     let tokenizer = Tokenizer::from_file(tokenizer_path)?;
+     
+     Ok(tokenizer)
+ }
+ 
+ fn create_list_array_from_vectors(vectors: &amp;[Vec&lt;i64&gt;]) -&gt; Result&lt;ListArray&gt; {
+     // Create a flattened array of all values
+     let mut flattened = Vec::new();
+     let mut offsets = Vec::new();
+     let mut current_offset = 0;
+     
+     offsets.push(current_offset);
+     
+     for vector in vectors {
+         for &amp;value in vector {
+             flattened.push(value);
+         }
+         current_offset += vector.len() as u32;
+         offsets.push(current_offset);
+     }
+     
+     // Create arrays
+     let values_array = Int64Array::from(flattened);
+     let offsets_array = UInt32Array::from(offsets);
+     
+     // Create list array
+     let list_array = ListArray::try_new(
+         Arc::new(Field::new("item", DataType::Int64, false)),
+         Arc::new(offsets_array),
+         Arc::new(values_array),
+         None,
+     )?;
+     
+     Ok(list_array)
+ }
  
```
